definition: Maracana has been rebuilt and modernized across its life.
description: Renovations at Maracana: new stands, new roofs, new hospitality — the endless modernization of the matchday. Each rebuild tries to add comfort without killing atmosphere, a balance few get right. The best renovations keep the old soul in the new body.

title: The future
